operation.required_first_output: A CR4-01 repairability classification. Only A or B authorize repair in the same movement; C, D or E require STOP and report.

cr4_01_repairability.question: Can capability loss be made mechanically typed without inventing semantic vocabulary that neither L1 nor the admitted source lineage authorizes?
cr4_01_repairability.answer: YES. The individuating basis already exists in admitted, digest-verified source. The founder's proposed direction — individuate loss by the semantic obligation being lost rather than by an invented capability taxonomy — is not merely the cleaner option; it is what the admitted lineage already requires, and v0.4 had authored a parallel scheme instead while citing the RCP capability vocabulary zero times.

grounding.RCP_5_2: Capability Resolver OUTPUT is 'a CapabilityDecision per semantic requirement'; SEMANTIC SOURCE MAP obligation is 'every decision references the RealityIR requirement it answers'.
grounding.RCP_5_3: A CLOSED five-member decision vocabulary already exists: SUPPORTED, SUBSTITUTED, DEGRADED, ABSENT, REFUSED.
grounding.INV_RC_CAP_1: Totality — 'Every semantic requirement receives exactly one decision. A requirement with no decision is a compilation error, not a default.'
grounding.INV_RC_KERNEL_4: Injective distinction — 'No admitted construct may encode a distinction already encoded by another admitted construct.' THIS IS THE CALIBRATION CR4-01 SAID WAS MISSING, and it was already admitted.
grounding.P_L1_C: Founder-sealed Semantic Source Map traces CapabilityDecision -> RealityIR transition -> SemanticProgram rule, under TRACEABILITY REQUIREMENT.
grounding.F_05_v0_2_INV_OBS_PER_2: Same pattern already adjudicated one layer over — 'A substrate that cannot SHALL say so at the named tier rather than satisfying the requirement at a lower tier silently.'

cr4_01_repairability.provenance_of_grounding: RCP v0.1 draft SHA-256 1aa3698c29ca9d471390d8943ab64afd7e5a5d943645062fe64451ba0938c776 — RECOMPUTED this movement and matching byte-for-byte the digest the authoring commission names as a GOVERNING RECORD. Admitted lineage, not a document reached for because it was convenient.
cr4_01_repairability.why_not_A: 'Semantic requirement' is named by RCP as a RealityIR entity. Identifying it with this document's clause identities is a derivation, disclosed at SP-167 rather than presented as source.
cr4_01_repairability.why_not_C: No founder decision must be made for the repair to be lawful. The repair REMOVES an authored vocabulary and substitutes references into a set the document already publishes. It is a narrowing and creates no new semantic terms.
cr4_01_repairability.why_not_D: The genuinely protocol-level objects — RCP §5.3's decision vocabulary and the CapabilityDecision record schema reserved to R-04 — are NOT installed, extended or pre-empted. SP-171 declines them; docket A-10 records the reconciliation as reserved. v0.5 supplies only the requirement identities a decision is taken per, which is a precondition of R-04 rather than an encroachment on it.
cr4_01_repairability.why_not_E: No source contradiction found; RCP §5, P-L1-C's source map and F-05's precedent all point the same way.
cr4_01_repairability.red_line_observed: No capability ontology was authored. No enum of substrate limitations — STORAGE_LIMITATION, UI_DEGRADATION, NETWORK_RESTRICTION or any sibling — exists anywhere in v0.5. Had individuation required inventing such a set, BLOCKED_BY_FOUNDER_OR_SOURCE_DECISION was the correct return and would have been returned.

cr4_01_repair.mechanism: The embodiment is removed from the naming role entirely. A CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED disposition no longer carries a declared loss class; it names a FAILED-REQUIREMENT SET of SP clause identities.

clauses.SP-167: Semantic requirement identity — the requirement set IS this document's normative clause set inside the SP-006 envelope: closed, enumerated, fixed at the candidate's digest. No embodiment may name a requirement the document does not state.
clauses.SP-168: Invocation is computed, not declared — each presented element invokes a determinate requirement set, a function of the element and the presented-sequence prefix only, published as a table at §2.0.1 and derivable by any reader.
clauses.SP-169: The failed-requirement set and its two-sided exactness — maximality (every invoked requirement it cannot honor is named) and minimality (no requirement it can honor is named), non-empty by construction.
clauses.SP-170: INV-RC-KERNEL-4 applied — two embodiments failing different requirements necessarily carry different sets, because the requirements ARE the distinctions. No coarser admissible name exists.
clauses.SP-171: The protocol boundary declined — no capability decision vocabulary installed; RCP §5.3 and R-04 neither authored nor pre-empted.
clauses.SP-151_SP-152_SP-155: Loss class withdrawn; SP-152 compares the failed-requirement set by clause identity; SP-155's veridicality becomes a two-sided test against the substrate.

cr4_01_repair.counterexample_rerun: CR-003 §3.5's pair: G' cannot hold a second pending contribution and names { SP-022 }; H' preserves no canonical order and names { SP-024 }. Sets differ, so SP-152 diverges at presented index 3. FT-16 added to close the residual escape where both declare one coarse common label — now inexpressible under SP-167 and forbidden by SP-170.

cr4_03_repair.defect: The auditor v0.4 published did not execute — SyntaxError at line 781, body duplicated with a divergent FT regex. True numbers, false provenance.
cr4_03_repair.repair_is_a_rule_not_a_seam: Per founder direction, the duplicate was not merely excised. The chain 'extract shipped bytes -> execute -> capture -> compare with published evidence' is installed as a machine check the program performs on itself.

checks.FENCE_PARSE_FAILURES: every python-tagged fence in the artifact is compile()d — a spliced or truncated payload cannot be published
checks.FENCE_DUPLICATE_PAYLOADS: every fence scanned for a contiguous run of >=5 substantial lines occurring twice — catches duplication that still parses
checks.SHIPPED_BYTES_EXECUTED: the running program re-extracts its own fence from the artifact and compares to the bytes it is executing; a nearby working copy cannot masquerade as the shipped program
checks.PUBLISHED_EVIDENCE_MATCH: the program compares its measurement block to the block published in §16.5, located by SECTION HEADING rather than a prose anchor that would match the script's own copy

cr4_03_repair.hazards_removed_at_source: The script never writes a literal triple-backtick (built as chr(96)*3), so its own body cannot terminate the fence carrying it. Every document anchor is a line-anchored regex rather than a bare string, so the script cannot match its own source and count itself.
cr4_03_repair.proof: v0.4 FAILS the new auditor: FENCE_PARSE_FAILURES [(665, 'unterminated string literal')], FENCE_DUPLICATE_PAYLOADS [(665, '50 duplicated lines')], SHAPE_AUDIT_RESULT FAIL. v0.5 PASSES with PUBLICATION_INTEGRITY PASS.
cr4_03_repair.stated_limit: PUBLICATION_INTEGRITY PASS proves the published bytes are the executed bytes and the published output is this program's output. It proves nothing about whether the measurements are the right measurements.
